title: fleet-guards: stderr redirect to $STATE defeats fleet_burn makedirs self-heal when state dir is gone
description: Codereview of rmza/jju8 interaction (correctness pass, kimi-k3). Guards invoke the helper as python3 ... 2>"$W_ERR" where W_ERR=$STATE/fleet_burn.err. Redirections open BEFORE the command runs, so if /tmp/fleet-driver-state vanished, the 2> open fails ENOENT and fleet_burn.py is never invoked — update()'s os.makedirs(state_dir, exist_ok=True) (rmza self-heal) never executes. WASTE empty every cycle, one deduped bd alarm, waste guard permanently blind until guards restart — the exact outcome the self-heal was added to eliminate. Fix: re-run mkdir -p "$STATE" inside the loop before the helper call (or move the err file outside $STATE).
close_reason: FIXED: scripts/fleet-guards.sh now re-creates $STATE inside the guards loop (mkdir -p "$STATE") immediately before the fleet_burn.py invocation, with a comment explaining the mechanism. Root cause verified: bash opens the 2>"$W_ERR" redirect BEFORE exec'ing the helper, so a vanished /tmp/fleet-driver-state made the helper never run and its os.makedirs self-heal (fleet_burn.py:86) never executed — WASTE empty every cycle, waste guard blind until restart. Behavioral demo: without mkdir, redirect fails ENOENT and helper never runs (rc=1); with mkdir, helper runs (rc=0). New regression guard scripts/test_fleet_guards_state_dir.py asserts the structural invariant (indented mkdir -p "$STATE" between 'while :; do' and the helper invocation) — loop body can't be executed in tests (real bd writes + provider API, per existing cycle_min test convention). Tests: 21/21 pass (1 new + 2 cycle_min + 18 fleet_burn); bash -n clean. 3x codereview (kimi-k3, all delegated): correctness PASS; edge-cases PASS; security 1 finding — pre-existing predictable-/tmp state dir exposure, deduped onto existing OPEN bead lbui (P3) with a comment adding the two new vectors (2> redirect follows planted fleet_burn.err symlink -> victim-file clobber; W_HINT tail echoes attacker content into operator logs) and noting fleet-headless.sh:23 + fleet-driver.sh:61,159,214 share the path so the mode-0700 move must migrate all consumers together.
